questions.title: What should happen when a note is unclear?
questions.help: Choose how the skill handles missing context.
questions.decision: Whether to draft with marked gaps or clarify before drafting

options.label: Draft and mark the gaps
options.effect: Create a useful draft while keeping uncertainty visible

options.label: Ask focused questions first
options.effect: Resolve material gaps before producing the draft

recommendation.rationale: A reviewable draft gives the reader context for the missing details.
assumptions: Unconfirmed details must remain visibly uncertain

questions.title: Which missing details should trigger a question?
questions.help: For example, ask about an uncertain deadline while leaving minor wording for the draft.
questions.decision: What counts as a material information gap

recommendation.value: Ask about ownership, commitments, deadlines, or contradictory evidence that changes the meaning.
recommendation.rationale: These gaps can change what the update promises or attributes to someone.

questions.title: What should the weekly update include?

options.label: Progress
options.effect: Summarize completed work with its practical result

options.label: Next steps
options.effect: List supported next actions without inventing owners or dates

options.label: Risks and open questions
options.effect: Keep blockers, assumptions, and unresolved items visible

recommendation.rationale: Readers can see what changed, what comes next, and where help is needed.
assumptions: Only the supplied notes support factual claims
